notes: `אֶת־הַגִּלְגָּל` here is the preposition H854 *with*, rendered *by*, not the object marker; MACULA tags it R, and the prepositional predicate takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 49).
The marginal note on *quarries* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The vocative article is `unrepresented` and the *O* stays with the noun (rule 36).
